info.name: Pioneer DDJ-RB
info.author: openDJ (from the DDJ-400 mapping by Warker, nschloe, dj3730, jusko, Robert904)
info.description: openDJ's mapping for the Pioneer DDJ-RB, written from AlphaTheta's MIDI message list on top of openDJ's DDJ-400 mapping: the DDJ-RB numbers its decks, mixer and browser as the DDJ-400 does, with its pads on MIDI channels 8 and 9 and a second FX unit on channel 6.
